title: Treasure Hunt on a Mysterious Island!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
One-two! One-two!
Warm-up complete!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Warming up before a treasure hunt is essential, y'know!
You'd better do yours properly too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unfamiliar location, a bizarre Umamusume, pre-treasure hunt warm-ups...
I couldn't even begin to comprehend what was happening.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, can you even hear me?
Hello? Hellooo? Hellllloooooo?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ring-a-ding-ding, ring-a-ding-ding♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for calling. This is the
'Golshi-chan All-Purpose Consultation Center.'

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Is your dilemma on an international scale?
Global scale? Or perhaps a cosmic scale?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
For every single question asked,
we're sending two whole troubles your way, totally free♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, that's not cosmic at all!
That's just a tiny, run-of-the-mill personal question.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, guess I got no choice.
Since I'm feelin' generous, I'll let ya in on the secret for practically free.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Listen up: we took the animal trail behind Tracen Academy,
passed through a cave, pushed past the jungle, and landed right here...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: In other words, somewhere on Planet Earth.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't get your knickers in a twist!
I don't remember the way back either, but as long as we're on Earth, we'll get home eventually!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: More importantly, you haven't forgotten why we came here, have ya?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hear this: there's an incredible treasure here.
A real gem guaranteed to make me the strongest Umamusume alive!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Our mission today is to dig it up,
so you'd better search with all ya got!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, treasure hunt, start～♪
*Ba-dum tsssh!* Holler the second you spot something shiny～!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without understanding a single thing about my situation,
I was forcibly dragged into a treasure hunt...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few hours later—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oho! Battered old canoe spotted in a place like this～!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ho! Look at all those holes! One hundred people get on, and it's instant sinking!
Guaranteed to take on water in no time!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And over here, we have...
—Aha! The classic treasure hunting trope: a mysterious rubber boot!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: *Sniff, sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, the scent of the fishing industry...
Memories of distant days on a tuna boat... Deep-sea trawling flashes before my eyes...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, what am I doing?!
Now's not the time to get all sentimental! We're here for treasure!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship had been making a racket like this ever since we arrived.
What in the world was she actually looking for?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Whatcha starin' at over there?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it☆
You're totally captivated by Golshi-chan's cuteness, aren'tcha♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I can't blame ya, but...
Lookin' without permission is a big no-no☆
choice_data_list: What specifically are we supposed to be looking for...?
What specifically are we supposed to be looking for...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, obviously something that looks like treasure.
Beyond that: don't think, feeel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That made it even less clear what we were looking for...
For now, maybe handing her something lying around would suffice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then, I noticed a coconut rolling around nearby.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Marching on～, marching on, far and wide～～♪
Come on out～, come on out, treasure trooove～～♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Hm?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...WHAAAAT?!
WOOOOAAAAAHHHH?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's...!! The soothing fruit born of tropical lands...!
Wait, are you a genius or somethin'?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yaaahooo～♪ That's the exact treasure I was lookin' for!!
Put it down on the ground, quick!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I could hardly believe it,
but apparently, this was genuine treasure in Gold Ship's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following her instructions, I placed the coconut on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, stand back.
Things are about to get too dangerous for an amateur...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: *Inhaaaale*...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —HOOOWAAATAAAAGHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*CRACK-SHATTER!!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship split the rock-hard coconut clean open with her bare hands!
What utterly fearless willpower and bottomless strength...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
Heheh, split clean in two.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Timing's pretty good, so let's take a break.
Here, take a seat, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I took the coconut half from her and sat down on a piece of driftwood... (To be continued)
